metadata.title: Websites and online stores for small businesses — PROSTO
metadata.description: Landing pages, business websites and online stores. A team of two: you talk directly to the developers, from first call to launch and support.

hero.title: We build websites that simply work
hero.lead: We're a team of two. We build landing pages, business websites, online stores and Telegram bots — from the first call to launch and support.

about.title: Two developers instead of a whole agency
about.lead: You talk directly to the people building your website. No middlemen, no endless approvals.

noJargon.title: We explain without jargon
noJargon.text: We talk about your business and customers, not frameworks.

handover.title: Everything is yours
handover.text: Code, domain, hosting and all access are registered in your name.

services.title: What we do
services.note: Cost and timeline depend on the project — we'll give you an exact quote after a short call.

portfolio.title: Our work
portfolio.note: Projects we built ourselves. All of them are live.

talk.title: Call
talk.text: We learn what you do, who the website is for and what your budget is.

structure.title: Structure
structure.text: We agree on the page plan before any design work.

build.title: Design & development
build.text: We build for phones first and show you work in progress.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: We set up the domain, hosting, request forms and analytics.

support.title: Support
support.text: After launch, we keep updating and improving your website.

contacts.title: Tell us what website you need
contacts.responseTime: We'll reply within [N] hours on business days.

contactForm.title: Website request
contactForm.messageLabel: About your project and how to reach you
contactForm.messagePlaceholder: What you do, what the website should do, which websites you like. And where you'd like to chat: WhatsApp or Telegram?
contactForm.consent: By sending a request, you confirm that you have read our <link>privacy policy</link>.
contactForm.successTitle: Thank you! We've got your request
contactForm.error: We couldn't send your request. Please try again or message us on <link>Telegram</link>.

errors.name: Please tell us what to call you
errors.phoneInvalid: Please check the number — it doesn't look right

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data we receive when you send a request through our website, why we need it and how we protect it. We only collect what we need to reply to your request.

controller.title: Who we are
controller.text: The controller of your personal data is [full name or company name, address]. For any questions about your data, write to <email>{address}</email>.

data.title: What data we receive
data.text: Your name, phone number, the service you chose and your message — whatever you enter in the request form. We also see which language version of the site you used. When you visit the site, our hosting provider automatically records technical data: IP address, browser type and request time. Providing data is voluntary, but without your name and phone number we won't be able to reply.

purpose.title: Why we process it and on what basis
purpose.text: We use the form data to reply to your request, discuss your project and prepare an offer. These are steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Technical data is needed to run and secure the website, which is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We don't use your data for newsletters and we don't sell it.

recipients.title: Who else has access
recipients.text: Requests reach us via Telegram, so they are processed by the Telegram service. The website is hosted by Vercel. These providers may process data outside the European Economic Area — in that case with the safeguards required by the GDPR, in particular the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. We don't share your data with anyone else unless the law requires it.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: We keep your request while we discuss working together, and no longer than [12 months] after our last contact. If we sign a contract, we'll keep the data for as long as the law requires.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.outro: To exercise any of these rights, write to us — we'll reply within one month.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The website stores only one cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, to remember your chosen language. We don't use analytics or advertising cookies.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: If anything changes — for example, if we add analytics — we'll update this page and the date at the top.

rightsList.access: find out what data we hold about you and get a copy;
rightsList.portability: receive your data in a convenient format or have it transferred to another controller;
rightsList.objection: object to processing based on our legitimate interest;
rightsList.complaint: lodge a complaint with a data protection authority — in Poland, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO).

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.text: An error occurred while loading the page. Please try again or go back to the homepage.
